purpose: Single source of truth for distinguishing scheduled live runs of the graded DCA task from manual runs, so downstream slippage/watchdog/weekly reporting never confuses the two. Every run_state artifact must carry a run_classification block matching this policy.

live_task.lineage_note: 10ce362c is the repaired live task; it supersedes the deleted ce16ba6b. The artifact root stays under .../ce16ba6b for continuity across the repair.
live_task.name: Graded DCA automatic live test - $3 allocation

scheduled_run_classification.lineage_rule: A scheduled run is valid evidence when cron_id='10ce362c' OR supersedes_cron_id='ce16ba6b', so continuity artifacts written before/after the repair both remain valid.

scheduled: Update latest_scheduled_run.json to point at the just-written scheduled run.
run_classification.run_origin must be 'scheduled' and manual_run must be false.
manual: NEVER update latest_scheduled_run.json from a manual run.
run_classification.run_origin must be 'manual' and manual_run must be true with a distinct run_id.

rules: Validate scheduled state files against run_classification.schema.json before use.
Collect every order_id found in manual_runs/**/run_state*.json and exclude them from all scheduled-live metrics.
Exclude any run_state whose run_classification has run_origin='manual' or manual_run=true, regardless of where the file is located on disk.
Never infer scheduled status from same-day broker orders alone; a valid scheduled run_state must exist.
Scheduled-live cost basis, slippage, reliability, and order-count metrics must be computed only from validated scheduled runs with manual order IDs excluded.

conditions: A valid scheduled run_state exists (run_origin='scheduled', passes schema validation).
The scheduled run_state lacks order IDs due to a known/recorded write failure.
Only broker orders inside the scheduled window (15:15-15:35 ET) on the scheduled trading day may be attributed.
constraints: Manual order IDs (from manual_runs/**/run_state*.json) must still be excluded even under fallback.
Fallback is never allowed when no valid scheduled run_state exists.
Fallback must not attribute orders from a run classified as manual.

rules: Manual fills may be reported only inside a clearly labeled 'Manual Test Runs' section.
Manual fills must not affect scheduled-live cost basis.
Manual fills must not affect scheduled-live slippage.
Manual fills must not affect scheduled-live reliability.
Manual fills must not affect scheduled-live order-count metrics.
